function.name: Services_1_BookAppointment
function.description: Book an appointment with a hair stylist or salon. The appointment time and date must be specified. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

stylist_name.description: The full name of the hair stylist or the name of the salon.

appointment_time.description: The time of the appointment in 24-hour format (HH:MM).

appointment_date.description: The date for the appointment in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

function.name: Services_1_FindProvider
function.description: Search for a hair stylist in a specified city, with the option to filter by whether the salon is unisex. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city where the salon is located, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'New York, NY').

is_unisex.description: Flag indicating if the salon is unisex. True for unisex, False for gender-specific.

function.name: Weather_1_GetWeather
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified city on a certain date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The name of the city for which the weather is being requested, such as 'Los Angeles' or 'New York'.

date.description: The date for which the weather forecast is desired, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If not provided, the default is the current date.
